title: The Engineering Design Process
seo_title: Grade 6 Engineering Design Worksheets: Criteria, Constraints, Decision Matrices and Testing
standard_text: Define the criteria and constraints of a design problem with sufficient precision to ensure a successful solution, taking into account relevant scientific principles and potential impacts on people and the natural environment that may limit possible solutions.
meta_desc: Free middle school science worksheets on the engineering design process (NGSS MS-ETS1-1 to MS-ETS1-4): criteria and constraints, decision matrices, combining the best features and iterative testing. 100 practice questions with answers.
key_sub: Precise criteria and constraints, a decision matrix and repeated testing help engineers find the best solution.
body_html:
How to think about it

Engineers solve problems with a design process:

  1. Define the problem with precise criteria (what it must do) and constraints (limits like cost, time, materials and environmental impact).
  2. Brainstorm several solutions.
  3. Compare solutions with a decision matrix that scores each one against the criteria.
  4. Build a prototype or model and test it.
  5. Analyze the data, combine the best features and improve the design. Test again.

In every test, change only one thing so the results are fair.

Example

“It must cost less than $10.” Criterion or constraint?

It is a limit.

Answer: constraint

Example

Design A scores 4, 3, 5; Design B scores 5, 4, 2. Which total is higher?

A: 4 + 3 + 5 = 12

B: 5 + 4 + 2 = 11

Answer: Design A

Common mistakes

  • Mixing up criteria (goals) and constraints (limits).
  • Stopping after the first test.
  • Changing several things at once in one test.

faq.q: What is the difference between criteria and constraints?
faq.a: Criteria are what a design must do to succeed. Constraints are limits such as cost, time, materials and size.
A table that scores each possible solution against the criteria so they can be compared fairly.

faq.q: Why do engineers test and improve designs many times?
faq.a: Each test gives data that shows what to fix. Combining the best features and testing again makes the design better.

It must be finished by Friday.

items.q: Why should criteria be precise, like “hold 2 kg” instead of “be strong”?
